contradictions.summary: On May 11, 2025, Zoe from Puck confirmed that Brighton Fringe leadership admitted they had been plotting a takeover of Half a Camel for 'a little while'. The call also confirms the Fringe contacted Ben’s GP to allege delusions and paranoia, offered contracts directly to partners, and never informed Ben of any plan. Zoe refused to cooperate and affirmed her support for Ben. This confirms the takeover was premeditated and executed under false pretenses.
